description: Short real-run smoke for 37_lejepa: pretrain -> encoder.pt -> linear_eval, one epoch on tiny real-shaped ImageFolder data. Discovered and driven by tests/test_real_run_smoke.py and bin/matrix-run.py (docs/REAL_RUN_VERIFICATION.md steps 2-3). Lives in the method's own directory so no shared file names a method. This is a timm-backed ViT method (vit_base_patch16_224), so `needs` lists timm; train.img_size stays divisible by the patch size 16 (64, timm interpolates the position embedding), train.views is shrunk for the multi-view forward, and train.warmup_epochs is zeroed for the one-epoch schedule.
